description: List ALL DNS records per subdomain (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA) as an additive dns_records dict on SubdomainResult, resolved via the existing dig-arg-list pattern with a stdlib fallback, surfaced as a single compact CSV column (position 15) and a per-subdomain Records panel in the UI. Purely additive: does NOT change ip_addresses/cname/cname_chain or the first 12 CSV columns. Sequenced AFTER FEAT-001 because both edit SubdomainResult, analyze_subdomain, CSV_COLUMNS/download_csv, and static/index.html; running sequentially avoids index/merge churn in those shared regions.
steps: In main.py add `DNS_RECORD_TYPES = ['A','AAAA','CNAME','MX','NS','TXT','SOA']` near the DNS helpers (~line 760) and `def _dig_records(host) -> dict[str, list[str]]` near _dig_cname (~line 902). For each type run subprocess.run(['dig','+short','<TYPE>',host], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5) — ARGUMENT LIST, no shell=True — and parse +short lines into a list (strip, drop empties, rstrip trailing dot where appropriate). Return a dict containing only types that produced answers (omit or empty-list the rest). Call is_valid_hostname(host) first and return {} for invalid hosts. On FileNotFoundError (dig absent) fall back to stdlib: A/AAAA via socket.getaddrinfo and CNAME via _socket_cname, leaving MX/NS/TXT/SOA empty (documented limitation). Never raise — on any other exception return whatever was gathered.
Add `async def resolve_dns_records(host) -> dict` wrapping _dig_records with loop.run_in_executor(None, _dig_records, host) so the subprocess work stays off the event loop; return {} on error.
Add `dns_records: dict` to the SubdomainResult TypedDict (~line 441).

In analyze_subdomain (~line 1164) call `dns_records = await resolve_dns_records(sub)` inside the existing `async with sem:` block (reusing the bound concurrency) and set dns_records on the main return; set dns_records={} on the invalid-hostname early return (~line 1174). Do NOT modify ip_addresses, cname, or cname_chain.

Add `def _dns_records_to_cell(records) -> str` producing a compact one-line serialization: join values within a type by comma and types by ';', e.g. 'A=1.2.3.4;MX=10 mail.x;NS=ns1.x,ns2.x;TXT=...'. Append 'dns_records' to CSV_COLUMNS (~line 1636) as the LAST column (position 15, after takeover_evidence from FEAT-001). In the download_csv writer loop append _csv_safe(_dns_records_to_cell(r.get('dns_records', {}))).

Frontend static/index.html: add a per-subdomain 'Records' affordance (a small ▸/button in the Subdomain cell inside renderTable, ~line 536) that toggles a detail <tr> listing A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/NS/TXT/SOA from r.dns_records, each value escapeHtml-ed (textContent-equivalent). Keep the main row uncluttered; do not alter the existing columns. The toggle must be XSS-safe (no innerHTML of raw server data).

Add tests/test_dns_records.py (offline, following tests/test_dns_status.py monkeypatch pattern): monkeypatch the subprocess runner (main.subprocess.run) to return canned `dig +short` output per TYPE and assert _dig_records / resolve_dns_records populate dns_records correctly for A/MX/NS/TXT; a dig-absent path (subprocess.run raising FileNotFoundError) leaves MX/NS/TXT/SOA empty while still returning A/AAAA/CNAME via the stdlib fallback (monkeypatch socket.getaddrinfo/_socket_cname).

Update tests/test_api.py: add dns_records={} to the SubdomainResult fixture and finalize test_download_csv_header to expect the full 15-column header ending with dns_records (len==15), the first 12 unchanged in order, and takeover_verdict/takeover_evidence/dns_records at indices 12/13/14. Assert a dns_records cell starting with a trigger char is _csv_safe-neutralized.
acceptance_criteria: SubdomainResult has a dns_records dict; analyze_subdomain populates it inside the Semaphore-bound block and leaves ip_addresses/cname/cname_chain unchanged.
_dig_records uses an argument-list dig call (no shell), is_valid_hostname-gates the host, and falls back to stdlib A/AAAA/CNAME when dig is absent with MX/NS/TXT/SOA empty.
dns_records parsing populates A/MX/NS/TXT from canned dig output in tests; the dig-absent path still returns A/AAAA/CNAME.
CSV gains a single trailing dns_records column (position 15), _csv_safe-neutralized and ';'-delimited so it never breaks the comma CSV; first 12 columns unchanged.
Frontend exposes a per-subdomain Records panel listing all record types, every value XSS-safe, without cluttering or breaking the existing columns.
All 130 baseline tests plus FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 tests pass.
findings:
FEAT-002 complete. Purely additive dns_records implemented end-to-end. Backend (main.py): new constant DNS_RECORD_TYPES=['A','AAAA','CNAME','MX','NS','TXT','SOA'] placed just before _dig_dns_status (~line 785). New sync helper _dig_records(host)->dict[str,list[str]] and stdlib-fallback _socket_records(host) added right after resolve_cname_chain (before check_http); plus async wrapper resolve_dns_records(host) using loop.run_in_executor. _dig_records gates host via is_valid_hostname (returns {} for invalid), runs ['dig','+short','',host] as an argument list (no shell), timeout=5 per type, strips trailing dots on all types except TXT, de-dupes, omits types with no answers, swallows TimeoutExpired per-type, and on FileNotFoundError (dig absent) delegates to _socket_records which fills A/AAAA (getaddrinfo, AF split) and CNAME (_socket_cname) only — MX/NS/TXT/SOA stay empty (documented limitation). Never raises. SubdomainResult TypedDict gained 'dns_records: dict' as the LAST field (after cname_chain). analyze_subdomain sets dns_records=await resolve_dns_records(sub) inside the existing `async with sem:` block (reuses the bound concurrency) and on the main return; the invalid-hostname early return sets dns_records={}; the inner SubdomainResult built for verify_takeover also carries it. ip_addresses/cname/cname_chain and the first 12 CSV columns are UNCHANGED. CSV: new _dns_records_to_cell(records)->str serializes 'TYPE=v1,v2;TYPE2=...' in DNS_RECORD_TYPES order (unknown keys appended) and '' for empty; 'dns_records' appended to CSV_COLUMNS as the 15th/last column (index 14) and the writer appends _csv_safe(_dns_records_to_cell(r.get('dns_records',{}))). FINAL 15-COLUMN HEADER: subdomain,ip_addresses,cname,http_status,https_status,sources,resolved,alive,takeover_risk,takeover_service,takeover_detail,dns_status,takeover_verdict,takeover_evidence,dns_records. Frontend (static/index.html): added JS whitelist const DNS_RECORD_TYPES, dnsRecordsPanel(records) (escapeHtml-es every value, labels from the fixed whitelist, '
'-joins multi-values, 'No DNS records found.' when empty), and toggleRecords(idx) that toggles a hidden detail . renderTable now maps with (r, idx); the Subdomain cell gained a ▸/▾ toggle button; a detail holds the panel. Verified XSS-safe via a Node spot-check (script/quote/ampersand payloads come out escaped). Tests: new tests/test_dns_records.py (6 tests) monkeypatches main.subprocess.run with canned per-TYPE dig output (A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/NS/TXT/SOA), asserts parsing, async wrapper, invalid-host gate, per-type timeout tolerance, dig-absent stdlib fallback (A/AAAA/CNAME present, MX/NS/TXT/SOA absent), and the cell serialization. tests/test_api.py: fixture gained dns_records and test_download_csv_header now asserts len==15, header[14]=='dns_records', first 12 columns unchanged, and the trailing cell content. tests/test_security.py: injection fixture gained dns_records with a '='-leading pseudo-type key so the serialized cell starts with a trigger char, and the test asserts row[14] is _csv_safe-neutralized. Full suite: 146 passed (140 prior + 6 new). Note: two older SubdomainResult(...) fixtures in test_security.py (test_api_key_never_leaks) omit the newer additive fields; harmless at runtime (TypedDict is runtime-dict and the CSV writer uses .get() for the additive cells) and those tests pass.
